notes: My Shelf is a set of materials the user owns/has access to; it intentionally has no stock quantity or production consumption.
Regulatory values are a separate layer from olfactory descriptors.
Unknown regulatory data must remain unknown/LOOKUP_REQUIRED, never interpreted as unrestricted.
Olfactory pyramid placement is a suggested formulation/UI classification, not a fixed physical property; keep confidence and allow user override.
regulatory_ui_rules: Show IFRA Category 4 limit as percent of finished consumer product, not perfume concentrate.
Show EU Annex III max-use limits separately from allergen labeling thresholds.
For EU-prohibited materials, show a blocking red warning for EU cosmetic formulation.
For LOOKUP_REQUIRED, show a neutral warning: regulatory data not verified; never display Safe/Unrestricted.
For naturals, restricted constituents may contribute to IFRA limits; prefer supplier analytical data or IFRA contributions annex.
olfactory_pyramid_ui_rules: Render a three-segment pyramid icon for each material: Top, Heart, Base.
Highlight every segment whose pyramid_highlight_* flag is true. TH highlights Top+Heart; HB highlights Heart+Base; THB highlights all three.
Functional carriers/solvents use ui_code NONE and should display a neutral functional icon instead of highlighting the pyramid.
Low-confidence placements are still suggested, but show a subtle dotted/question treatment and label them Suggested.

Pyramid placement is contextual and may shift with dosage, dilution and formula. Allow users to override the recommendation in their personal material profile without changing the global catalog record.
